pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Cross in the Mountains - the dark fir covered summit rising against the evening sky with the crucifix standing at the very top of the rock, the last gold light of the sun breaking up from behind the hill in long rays, a song of ascents, I lift up my eyes to the hills, from where does my help come, my help comes from the LORD
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_heuvels

pictures.scene: Konrad Witz, Saint Christopher - the great bearded man in the red cloak wading up to his chest in the green river with his staff planted in the water, the Christ child with the gold halo riding on his shoulder, the white cliffs and the lake with its little boats behind him and the hills and the open sky above, the Maker of heaven and earth, He will not allow your foot to slip, your Protector will not slumber
pictures.name: pd_witz_christoffel

pictures.scene: Masaccio, Saint Peter Healing the Sick with his Shadow - Peter in the gold cloak striding down the Florentine street with John behind him, his shadow falling across the old beggar kneeling in his path and the crippled man on the ground, the pale palazzo walls and the blue sky standing above them, behold the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep, the LORD is your keeper, the LORD is the shade on your right hand
pictures.name: pd_masaccio_schaduw

pictures.scene: David Davies, Moonrise - the pale gold moon standing just above the dark ridge of the hill with the mauve twilight sky filling the whole upper half of the picture, the sandy track winding up through the dry grass and one small figure on the skyline, the sun will not strike you by day nor the moon by night, the LORD will guard you from all evil
pictures.name: pd_davies_maan

pictures.scene: Rudolf Koller, The Gotthard Mail Coach - the four white horses galloping down the pass road with the yellow coach behind them and the postilion in the red waistcoat lifting his whip, the cattle scattering out of the way along the verge and the blue sky over the mountain road, He will preserve your soul, the LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore
pictures.name: pd_koller_gotthardpas

lines.text: I lift up my eyes to the hills.
From where does my help come?
My help comes from the LORD,
the Maker of heaven and earth.
He will not allow your foot to slip;
the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
The sun will not strike you by day,
The LORD will guard you from all evil;
The LORD will watch over your coming and going,
